note: Resident-dot state (dot-state-paths.ts DOT_STATE_ROOT) partitions by tier/tenant and personal owner: scoped inboxes, private action/wake evidence, inbound events, work results, KR measurements, outcomes, autonomy, arbitration and memory. Flat or tenant-only legacy state requires explicit reviewed operator migration for a live tenant (pnpm kyberion dot migrate-state); never infer historical tier from the current charter. When a tenant is offboarded, its legacy dot/tenants/<slug>/ copy is exported and soft-deleted automatically with the other tenant runtime state (audited SCOPE_OFFBOARD_SOFT_DELETE; owner decision 2026-11-05). Load-bearing append-only state: deleting it can replay triggers or effects. Event-continuations retain immutable adoption offsets, bounded pending entries and unresolved dispatch attempts; never TTL-delete or capacity-evict them. Feed cursors and seen-key rings are durable state, not cache. No automatic deletion; tenant offboarding and owner retention require audited review.
